# Video script: Setting up for the heart

> DRAFT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE. Contains claims with status 'ai-extracted' that no clinician has verified.

Unit D2 | Target length: 5 min

| # | Shot | Narration | Claims |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Machine console, probe selection | Use the highest frequency that still gets through. If the wall is thick, or it is the third trimester, harmonics help. | IS23-012, IS23-013 |
| 2 | Screen: obstetric preset image, then cardiac preset image, side by side | The heart needs a high frame rate, low persistence, one focal zone and a narrow field. The cardiac preset usually gives you these. | IS23-014 |
| 3 | Screen: zooming until the heart fills the frame | Zoom until the heart fills at least a third to a half of the screen. | IS23-015 |
| 4 | Screen: scrolling back through a cine-loop | Use the cine-loop. Watch the valves open and close through the whole cycle. | IS23-016 |
| 5 | Presenter | If the fetus is lying badly, more time or a second examination may be needed. | IS23-056 |
